articles.author: Evan Semones
articles.title: Apple changes name of Lake Ontario to ‘Lake America’ in maps app - Al Jazeera
articles.description: The change marks the second US-based tech giant to comply with President Donald Trump’s controversial order.
articles.content:
The tech company Apple has updated the label for Lake Ontario to Lake America for users of its map application in the United States, after direct lobbying by President Donald Trump.
